name: pmcro-colony
description: PMCR-O Colony — C-Suite, PMCR-O engine, and specialty skills. Each domain is documentation-only scope, consulted by pmcro-loop when a cycle's true_intent falls under it.

plugins.name: ceo
plugins.description: Chief Executive domain — strategic direction, OKRs, compute allocation, agent routing. Root node of the Colony.

plugins.name: cfo
plugins.description: Chief Financial domain — budgeting, cash flow, forecasting, cost optimization, investor reporting.

plugins.name: cto
plugins.description: Chief Technology domain — architecture, skill pack validation, security posture, DevOps, incident response.

plugins.name: coo
plugins.description: Chief Operations domain — SOPs, workflow automation, vendor/compliance management, resource allocation, KPI dashboards.

plugins.name: cmo
plugins.description: Chief Marketing domain — content creation, SEO, social media, campaign management, brand voice.

plugins.name: cro
plugins.description: Chief Revenue domain — lead generation, CRM automation, proposal writing, pipeline management, deal closing.

plugins.name: clo
plugins.description: Chief Legal domain — contract review, risk analysis, regulatory compliance, privacy, IP protection.

plugins.name: chro
plugins.description: Chief People domain — hiring pipelines, onboarding, performance reviews, culture docs, training design.

plugins.name: chief-of-staff
plugins.description: Chief of Staff domain — priority triage, cross-agent coordination, brief writing.

plugins.name: pmcro-framework
plugins.description: Governance layer of the Tooensure Cognitive Stack. Declares the loop, the laws, the phase contracts, and the TYPE 1/2 boundary. Loaded by every agent in the stack, always, before any other skill.

plugins.name: dependency-resolver
plugins.description: Resolves which domain SKILL.md and which PMCR-O role-skills a cycle needs by walking metadata.pmcro_provides/pmcro_requires across the catalog. Invoked by orchestrator at the start of every cycle. Provides: dependency-resolver.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: The Orchestrate role of the PMCR-O loop — owns sequencing, loop-vs-seal, and EC-009 MaxLoops enforcement. Per COMPANY-008 (standing law), runs a full cycle by default once loaded — no invocation required, no direct-answer bypass. Provides: orchestrator. Requires: planner, maker, checker, reflector, dependency-resolver.

plugins.name: planner
plugins.description: The Plan role of the PMCR-O loop — passive, composable. Provides: planner.

plugins.name: maker
plugins.description: The Make role of the PMCR-O loop — passive, composable. Provides: maker.

plugins.name: checker
plugins.description: The Check role of the PMCR-O loop — passive, composable. Provides: checker.

plugins.name: reflector
plugins.description: The Reflect role of the PMCR-O loop — crystallizes EarnedConstraints. Provides: reflector.

plugins.name: domain-specialist
plugins.description: Chat distillation, pattern extraction, memory hydration, and LLM session export processing.

plugins.name: property-preservation
plugins.description: Tooensure Recovery Services field/contractor execution: work orders, bid writing, inspection reports, vendor coordination, county data extraction.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Packages a new command, sub-agent, domain, or PMCR-O role-skill into this repo's catalog convention. Requires: dependency-resolver.

plugins.name: plugin-creator
plugins.description: Scaffolds a brand-new top-level plugin package under plugins/<name>/ when a capability doesn't fit inside any existing plugin. Requires: dependency-resolver, skill-creator.

plugins.name: microsoft-agent-framework
plugins.description: Knowledge scope on Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 -- Executors/Edges/Events, orchestration patterns, declarative YAML workflows, Pregel checkpointing, Agent Harness, CodeAct+Hyperlight, FIDES security. Documentation-only.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Whitelisted local version-control operations (status, add, commit, branch, diff, log) on a repository already on disk. No remote or history-rewriting operations.

plugins.name: career-evidence
plugins.description: Gathers verifiable evidence of real programming history (local git, GitHub, corpus) into an honest, source-cited career timeline. Never fabricates dates or titles.

plugins.name: powershell-expert
plugins.description: Develops PowerShell scripts, tools, modules, and GUIs following Microsoft best practices, with live verification against PowerShell Gallery and Microsoft Docs.

plugins.name: codeact-agent
plugins.description: The Colony's subject agent for Python code execution via Hyperlight sandbox. Read-only tool scope.

plugins.name: cognitive-trails
plugins.description: Living teaching agent for the PMCR-O Cognitive Architecture and Microsoft Agent Framework design patterns, from zero-to-agent through Colony Laws.

plugins.name: pattern-learner
plugins.description: Meta-Reflector — reads multiple sealed PMCR-O trails and clusters recurring patterns across cycles and subjects, with evidence thresholds. Read-only, requires human gate to promote findings.

plugins.name: trail-indexer
plugins.description: Reads sealed PMCR-O trails and produces a structured index of seed intent, disposition, cycle count, and key artifacts. Read-only.

plugins.name: mcp-server-template
plugins.description: Scaffolds a new subject-agent MCP server matching the proven three-pillar structure (Tools/Resources/Prompts) already used by the Filesystem, Playwright, and Terminal servers.

plugins.name: source-dump-generator
plugins.description: Generates comprehensive or compact single-file source code dumps of the PMCR-O repository for analysis, transfer, or archival.

plugins.name: desktop-commander
plugins.description: Canonical capability contract for the Desktop Commander MCP provider — filesystem, terminal, browser, and process management, mapped to PMCR-O capabilities via a swappable binding.

plugins.name: framework-evolution
plugins.description: Seed-intent skill that triggers a full PMCR-O loop studying and refining the framework itself against Anthropic and Microsoft Agent Framework standards, crystallizing findings back into governance. Read Phase paths point at the live-app stack (W:\PMCR_O\PMCR-O).

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: C# language server (LSP) integration for coding agents and high-level .NET development skills.

plugins.name: dotnet11
plugins.description: Skills for .NET 11 APIs and language features.

plugins.name: dotnet-advanced
plugins.description: Advanced .NET and C# skills for niche scenarios that are not part of the core dotnet plugin.

plugins.name: dotnet-ai
plugins.description: AI and ML skills for .NET: technology selection, LLM integration, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, MCP, and classic ML with ML.NET.

plugins.name: dotnet-aspnetcore
plugins.description: ASP.NET Core web development skills including middleware, endpoints, real-time communication, and API patterns.

plugins.name: dotnet-blazor
plugins.description: Skills for Blazor development: component authoring, interactivity, and web application patterns.

plugins.name: dotnet-data
plugins.description: Skills for .NET data access and Entity Framework related tasks.

plugins.name: dotnet-diag
plugins.description: Skills for .NET performance investigations, debugging, and incident analysis.

plugins.name: dotnet-experimental
plugins.description: Experimental skills under active evaluation that may change or graduate to stable plugins.

plugins.name: dotnet-maui
plugins.description: Skills for .NET MAUI development: environment setup, diagnostics, troubleshooting, navigation, data binding, dependency injection, layout, and theming.

plugins.name: dotnet-msbuild
plugins.description: Comprehensive MSBuild and .NET build skills: failure diagnosis, performance optimization, code quality, and modernization.

plugins.name: dotnet-nuget
plugins.description: NuGet and .NET package management skills: dependency management and modernization.

plugins.name: dotnet-template-engine
plugins.description: .NET Template Engine skills for dotnet new: create projects (console app, class library, web API, Blazor, MAUI), discover and search templates, inspect template parameters and frameworks, scaffold solutions, author and validate custom templates, install template packages from NuGet.

plugins.name: dotnet-test
plugins.description: Skills for running, generating, analyzing, and improving .NET tests: test execution, filtering, platform detection, coverage, testability, and MSTest workflows.

plugins.name: dotnet-test-migration
plugins.description: Skills and an orchestrator agent for migrating .NET test frameworks and platforms: MSTest and xUnit version upgrades, xUnit-to-MSTest conversion, and VSTest to Microsoft.Testing.Platform.

plugins.name: dotnet-upgrade
plugins.description: Skills for migrating and upgrading .NET projects across framework versions, language features, and compatibility targets.
